key.name: capture
key.description: Keybinding that captures the whole screen and opens rayshot for annotation.

key.name: binary
key.description: Absolute path of the rayshot binary. Empty means the rayshot found on PATH.

key.name: warm-overlay
key.description: Keep a resident overlay process with an initialized GPU so the editor appears faster, at the cost of some idle memory. When off, every capture starts a fresh overlay.
